name: Persistent Debounce
description: SQLite-backed inbound debounce queue that survives gateway restarts without duplicate replies.

dbPath.description: Path to SQLite database file. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/persistent-debounce.db

channels.description: Per-channel debounce configuration. Key is channel name (e.g. whatsapp).

accounts.description: Account IDs to apply debounce to. Empty means all accounts.

flushIntervalMs.description: How often to check for messages ready to flush (milliseconds)

maxPendingAgeMs.description: Maximum age for pending messages before they are auto-flushed or discarded
